title: Minimum White Tiles After Covering With Carpets
goal: Cover the most white tiles using a limited number of fixed-length carpets.
strategy: Prefix DP compares leaving the last tile uncovered with ending a carpet there. Overlap is allowed, so a carpet transition can jump to the prefix before its length without tracking previous carpet positions.

edgeCases: An all-black floor has no uncovered white cost
